title: Klopp's first match, at Tottenham
summary: Liverpool covered 116 kilometres, a league high for the season so far, in a goalless draw that was Klopp's first match in charge.

title: Klopp's first win, in the League Cup
summary: Klopp's first victory as Liverpool manager came in the League Cup, three days before his first league win at Chelsea.

title: First league win, at Chelsea
summary: Coutinho scored twice and Benteke once as Liverpool won at the reigning champions, with Firmino playing as a false nine.

title: Four goals at the Etihad
summary: Coutinho, Firmino and Škrtel scored, along with an own goal by Mangala, as Liverpool won 4–1 at Manchester City.

title: Five-four at Norwich, and broken glasses
summary: Adam Lallana scored the winner in a 5–4 win at Carrow Road, and Klopp's glasses were broken in the celebrations.

title: League Cup final lost on penalties
result: Liverpool 1–1 Manchester City (City won 3–1 on penalties)
summary: Coutinho equalised late on, but City won 3–1 on penalties after extra time in Klopp's first final as Liverpool manager.

title: Manchester United beaten in Europe
competition: Europa League round of 16, second leg
summary: Coutinho's away goal settled the tie at 3–1 on aggregate after a 2–0 first leg at Anfield, in the clubs' first European meeting.

title: Mané scores on his debut
summary: Sadio Mané scored on his debut in a 4–3 win at the Emirates, in a match Liverpool had led 4–1.

title: Leicester beaten in front of the new stand
summary: The champions were beaten on the first day the rebuilt Main Stand was in use at Anfield, with Firmino scoring twice.

title: Mané wins the derby in stoppage time
summary: Mané reacted first after Sturridge hit the post and scored into an empty net in stoppage time at Goodison Park.

title: Can's goal at Watford
summary: Emre Can's goal won the match at Vicarage Road and was later voted the club's goal of the season.

title: Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain signs from Arsenal
summary: Oxlade-Chamberlain joined on transfer deadline day, a midfielder who was in the last year of his contract at Arsenal.

title: Four conceded at Wembley
summary: Klopp took off Dejan Lovren after 31 minutes, and the defeat left Liverpool ninth in the table after nine league matches.

title: Five against Roma in the semi-final
summary: Salah scored twice against his former club and Milner made a record ninth assist of the campaign, before Liverpool went through 7–6 on aggregate.

title: Naby Keïta joins from RB Leipzig
summary: Liverpool confirmed Keïta's signing on 29 August 2017, and he joined on 1 July 2018, the same date as Fabinho.

title: Xherdan Shaqiri joins from Stoke City
summary: Shaqiri joined from relegated Stoke on 13 July, with Liverpool meeting the release clause in his contract.

title: Origi's stoppage-time derby winner
summary: Divock Origi scored from close range deep into stoppage time after Van Dijk's volley came back off the crossbar.

title: Alisson's save sends Liverpool through
summary: Salah scored and Alisson blocked Milik's shot in stoppage time, which kept Liverpool in the competition on goals scored.

title: Liverpool's only league defeat of the season
summary: Leroy Sané scored the winner 18 minutes from time, after goal-line technology showed John Stones had cleared a Mané rebound about a centimetre short of the line.

title: Bayern beaten in Munich
competition: Champions League round of 16, second leg
summary: Mané scored twice and Van Dijk headed in a corner as Liverpool won in Munich after a goalless first leg at Anfield.

title: Origi again, between the Barcelona legs
summary: Divock Origi headed in Shaqiri's free-kick four minutes from time, three days after the 3–0 first-leg defeat in Barcelona.

title: The European Cup parade
summary: An open-top bus carried the squad from Allerton Maze to the waterfront the day after the final in Madrid.

title: Super Cup won on penalties
summary: Liverpool won the Super Cup in Istanbul on penalties after extra time, with the new goalkeeper Adrián saving the decisive kick.

title: Late comeback at Villa Park
summary: Robertson equalised late on and Mané headed the winner in stoppage time, after Liverpool had trailed to a Trezeguet volley.

title: Manchester City beaten at Anfield
summary: Fabinho, Salah and Mané scored, leaving Liverpool eight points clear at the top of the table.

title: Four at Leicester, five days after Qatar
summary: Firmino scored twice, Milner scored a penalty with his first touch and Alexander-Arnold added the fourth, against the side then second in the table.

title: Salah's late goal beats United
summary: Van Dijk headed Liverpool in front early, and Salah finished after Alisson's long kick in stoppage time.

title: The unbeaten run ends at Watford
summary: Ismaïla Sarr scored twice and Troy Deeney once, ending a run of 44 league games without defeat.

title: Out of Europe against Atlético
competition: Champions League round of 16, second leg
summary: Atlético went through 4–2 on aggregate, ending the holders' defence of the trophy in Liverpool's last match in front of a crowd that season.

title: Four past Palace at an empty Anfield
summary: Alexander-Arnold, Salah, Fabinho and Mané scored, leaving Liverpool needing only Manchester City to drop points the next evening.
